common.appDescription: Smart tax filing assistant for Japan
common.welcomeSubtitle: Your intelligent assistant for Japanese tax filing. Manage income, build your tax profile, and calculate your obligations — all in one place.
common.errorBoundaryMessage: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

instructions.title: How to Use
instructions.body: TaxPilot helps you manage income records, build your tax profile, and calculate Japanese income tax. Start by adding income entries, then fill out your tax profile, and finally run the tax calculation.

onboarding.title: Create Your Account
onboarding.subtitle: Enter your name to get started with TaxPilot.

instructions.title: About Account Creation
instructions.body: Once you create your account, you can start recording income and managing your tax profile. Your data is securely stored and accessible only to you.

income.title: Income Entries
income.empty: No income entries yet. Add your first income entry to get started.
income.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this income entry?

instructions.title: Income Management Guide
instructions.body: View and manage all your income records here. Click 'Add Income' to create new entries, or click 'Delete' to remove records you no longer need. Income data is used for annual tax calculations.

instructions.title: How to Fill Out This Form
instructions.body: Enter amounts from your salary slip or income statement. Gross Amount is your pre-tax income. Social Insurance, Withholding Tax, and Resident Tax are deductions. You can find these in the 'Deductions' section of your payslip.

profile.title: Tax Profile
profile.noDefinition: No profile definition available for this tax year.
profile.notFound: No profile found for this year. Fill in the form to create one.

instructions.title: Tax Profile Guide
instructions.body: Your tax profile contains personal information and deduction items needed to calculate income tax. Basic Information includes core fields like spouse and dependents. Year-Specific Fields change based on annual tax law updates (e.g., fixed tax cuts, hometown tax). Having a spouse and dependents affects your deduction amounts.

validation.dependentsNonNegative: Number of dependents cannot be negative

upload.title: Upload Documents
upload.instruction: Drag and drop a financial document here, or click to browse.
upload.supportedFormats: Supported formats: PDF, Excel (.xlsx, .xls), Images (PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP, TIFF)
upload.success: Document processed successfully. An income entry has been created.

instructions.title: Document Upload Guide
instructions.body: Upload salary slips, bonus statements, or other income documents (PDF, Excel, or image formats). The system will automatically extract key information such as income type, amounts, and dates to create income records. For best results, ensure documents are clear and text is readable.

error.unsupportedType: Unsupported file type. Please upload a PDF, Excel, or image file.
error.uploadFailed: Failed to upload document. Please try again.
error.tooLarge: File is too large. Please upload a smaller file.

instructions.title: Tax Calculation Guide
instructions.body: Tax calculation requires that you have income entries and a tax profile for the selected year. Results include salary income, deductions, taxable income, income tax amount, and a recommended Furusato Nozei donation limit. The Furusato limit is the maximum donation amount that can be fully deducted (amounts above this limit cannot be deducted).

result.title: Calculation Results
result.furusatoNote: This is the estimated optimal donation limit for Furusato Nozei (Hometown Tax). Donations up to this amount can be fully deducted.

error.calculationFailed: Tax calculation failed. Please check your income entries and tax profile.
error.noData: Unable to calculate. Please ensure you have income entries and a tax profile for this year.
